title: Alpine Serenity
description: Traditional wooden chalets nestled on a green hillside beneath a dense pine forest and a dramatic limestone mountain peak.
altText: A row of traditional wooden alpine cabins on a green grassy hill with a dense pine forest and a rugged, rocky mountain face in the background under a cloudy sky.

title: Fresh Curry Prep
description: Prepping a vibrant mix of authentic, aromatic ingredients-including Thai eggplants, lemongrass, and fiery fresh green peppercorns-for a comforting local culinary experience.
altText: An overhead shot of chopped cooking ingredients on a wooden board, including round sliced purple eggplants, diced shallots, lemongrass stalks, dried lime leaves, and small green peppercorns.

title: Enchanted Woodland Trails
description: Getting lost in the details of the backcountry, where thick layers of vibrant green moss drape over ancient branches to create an atmospheric, fairytale canopy.
altText: A close-up view through a dense forest of pine trees, with thick green moss heavily coating the horizontal branches and tree trunks in the foreground.

title: First Glimpse of Krimml
description: Catching our very first peek of Europe's highest waterfall, thundering dramatically through a dense frame of towering alpine pines.
altText: A distant waterfall rushing over gray rocks, framed on both sides by tall, green evergreen trees in a dense forest.

title: The Power of the Alps
description: Feeling incredibly small standing right beside the massive, roaring cascades of Krimml as they plummet down mossy rock faces into the valley.
altText: A large, powerful waterfall cascading down a steep rocky cliff covered in green moss, partially framed by pine tree branches.

title: High-Angle Wonders
description: Looking down from the rocky forest trails at the sheer, unbridled force of the glacial river carving its path through Hohe Tauern National Park.
altText: A high-angle view of a large waterfall plunging down a rocky cliff next to a winding river, with a green valley and dense pine forest in the background.

title: Glacial Mist
description: Getting close enough to the crashing torrents to capture the legendary, crisp mountain spray that fills the entire forest air.
altText: A close-up shot of rushing white water creating thick mist as it crashes against dark, wet rocks covered in vibrant green foliage.

title: Framed by Nature
description: Peer through a natural window of towering evergreens to witness the dramatic, roaring drop of the Krimml Waterfalls.
altText: A vertical view of a powerful white waterfall cascading over rocks, framed symmetrically by dense, tall green pine trees in a mountain forest.

title: Peak Through the Pines
description: The sheer scale of Europe's highest waterfall reveals itself beautifully when framed by the mossy, ancient branches of the forest.
altText: A vertical shot looking through a gap in moss-covered tree trunks and green pines at a steep, misty waterfall rushing down a rocky mountain slope.

title: Thunderous Drops
description: Watching the middle tier of Krimml common-room giant plunge down rugged rock walls, surrounded by resilient pines that thrive in the permanent mountain mist.
altText: A powerful waterfall rushing down a steep, mossy cliff face with evergreen pine trees framing the foreground and top of the image.

title: Glacial Turquoise
description: Following the roaring, icy waters as they rush past moss-covered banks, showcasing the stunning contrast of white foam and deep turquoise currents.
altText: A two-tiered waterfall system rushing through a dense pine forest, with a lower cascade dropping into vibrant turquoise rapids surrounded by bright green, mossy rocks.
